## Volume II, Appendices A, B and C (NASA CR-92215)

Appendix A, soil specifications (70 items: a chemical analysis, a photomicrograph, a grain-size curve, a density chart and a friction-angle chart per soil, repeated under each soil of a material); Appendix B, the IITRI sonic modulus report (8); Appendix C, the direct shear program (44: 85 single tests on 15 soil and density series as data sheets, hand-drawn and computer-fitted envelopes, and friction angle versus relative density). `relation` links a figure to the one it reproduces or derives from, in either volume; `reproduces` rows hold no new numbers and are out of scope.
